; ===========================================================
; mazes.txt - prebuilt maze library for the A* Pathfinder
;
; FORMAT
;   MAZE <size> <name>      header (grid is size x size)
;   <size> rows of 0/1      1 = wall, 0 = open floor
;   END                     closes the maze
;
; Lines starting with ';' and blank lines are ignored.
; Start is always the top-left cell, goal the bottom-right
; cell (the program forces both open). You can add your own
; mazes by copying a block and editing it.
; ===========================================================
